title: The Radium Girls
author: Kate Moore
summary: In the 1910s and 20s, young women painted watch dials with radium paint and licked their brushes to a point. Kate Moore follows those who fell ill and their fight against the companies that denied responsibility.
readIf: you like narrative history about ordinary people who forced change in labor and safety law.
skipIf: you are squeamish about detailed accounts of illness and bodily decay.
